title: Sophia Girls Academy: More Than Just an Educational Platform
author: Sophia Girls Academy Journalism Department
description: Learn how Sophia Girls Academy was founded and how it is helping girls access educational opportunities around the world.

content.text: Not everyone grows up with the same opportunities. For many girls living in rural areas, finding information about scholarships, universities, or even someone to ask for advice can be difficult. Sophia Girls Academy was created to help change that.
How It Started
Sophia Girls Academy was founded by Bakdana and her friend Azhar. She knew how challenging it could be to find educational opportunities and prepare for exams.

Together, they created Sophia Girls Academy to provide free education, mentorship, and academic support for girls around the world. Their goal is simple: to help every girl reach her potential, no matter where she comes from.
Our Mission

Our goal is to support girls from rural areas by giving them access to educational and professional opportunities. We help students learn about scholarships, university admissions, international programs, and important exams while also teaching practical skills they can use in their studies and future careers.
More than anything, we want to build a community where ambitious girls can learn, grow, and support one another.
What We Offer

items: Basic Technical Skills (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)

content.text: Whether you're looking to improve your grades, prepare for university, or simply learn something new, there's a place for you here.
How the Program Works

The program officially starts on July 1. Students join WhatsApp groups based on the tracks they choose. Some mentors offer individual sessions through Calendly, while others teach through group lessons, workshops, and webinars.
Every two weeks, participants complete a short feedback form so we can continue improving the learning experience for everyone.

Sophia Girls Academy is more than an educational program. It's a community that believes every girl deserves the chance to reach her full potential. No matter where you come from, your future should be shaped by your ambitions, not by your location.

title: The Woman Who Founded One of the World’s Oldest Universities
author: Sophia Girls Academy Journalism Department
description: Learn how Sophia Girls Academy was founded and how it is helping girls access educational opportunities around the world.

content.text: When people hear the word university, they usually think of places like Oxford or Harvard. But did you know that one of the world’s oldest universities was founded by a woman over 1,100 years ago?
Her name was Fatima al-Fihri, and surprisingly, not many people know her story.
Who Was Fatima al-Fihri?

Fatima was born in the 9th century and later moved with her family to Fez, Morocco. Her father was a successful businessman who believed that education was important. After his death, Fatima and her sister inherited his wealth.
Many people would have spent that money on themselves, but Fatima had a different idea. She wanted to create something that would help people not only then, but in the future as well.
A Place Where Anyone Could Learn

In 859, Fatima used her inheritance to build a mosque. Over time, it became a place where people came not only to pray but also to study. It later grew into the University of al-Qarawiyyin, which is recognized as one of the oldest universities still operating today.

Students studied mathematics, astronomy, languages, medicine, philosophy, and many other subjects. People traveled from different places to learn there, and the university continued to grow for centuries.
Why Is Her Story Important?

When we talk about history, we often hear the names of scientists, inventors, or political leaders. But people like Fatima al-Fihri are just as important. She didn’t invent a new technology or make a scientific discovery. Instead, she created a place where thousands of people could learn.

Education gives people opportunities. It helps them build careers, solve problems, and improve their communities. Fatima understood that more than a thousand years ago, and her idea is still relevant today.
What Can We Learn From Her?
Fatima al-Fihri’s story shows that making a difference doesn’t always mean standing in the spotlight. Sometimes, creating opportunities for others has an even bigger impact.

At Sophia Girls Academy, we believe in the same idea. Every girl deserves access to education, support, and the chance to reach her goals. Fatima’s story reminds us that investing in education can change lives—not just for one person, but for generations to come.

title: The Woman Who Dared to Say Women Deserved More
author: Sophia Girls Academy Journalism Department
description: Discover how Margaret Fuller became one of the earliest voices advocating for women's education, equality, and the freedom to choose their own paths.

content.text: In July 1843, an essay called The Great Lawsuit was published in The Dial magazine. Today, many people consider it one of the first feminist works in American history. The woman behind it was Margaret Fuller.
Although her name isn’t as well known as many other historical figures, her ideas helped start important conversations about women’s rights and education.
Who Was Margaret Fuller?

Margaret Fuller was an American writer, editor, and journalist. At a time when women were expected to focus only on their homes and families, she believed they should also have access to education, meaningful careers, and the freedom to make their own choices.

She loved learning from a young age and spent years studying literature, history, philosophy, and different languages. Education became a big part of her life, and she wanted other women to have the same opportunities.
The Essay That Started a Conversation

In 1843, Fuller published The Great Lawsuit in The Dial, a literary magazine where she worked as an editor. In her essay, she argued that women should not be limited by society’s expectations. Instead, they should be able to learn, grow, and choose their own paths.
A few years later, she expanded these ideas into a book called Woman in the Nineteenth Century. It became one of the most influential early feminist books in the United States.
Why Does It Still Matter?
Today, it may seem normal for girls to go to school, attend university, and build careers in any field they choose. But in the 19th century, these opportunities were far from guaranteed.
Margaret Fuller believed that education gives people the freedom to think for themselves. She encouraged women to ask questions, develop their talents, and believe that their voices mattered.
Looking Back

More than 180 years have passed since The Great Lawsuit was first published, but its message is still relevant today. Around the world, many girls are still working to gain equal access to education and opportunities.

At Sophia Girls Academy, we believe in the same idea Margaret Fuller shared many years ago: every girl deserves the chance to learn, grow, and build the future she wants. Sometimes, real change begins with one person who is willing to speak up.
